__meta.source: CAPTURED LIVE from GET /serp/../appendix/user_data with valid credentials from a non-whitelisted IP
__meta.note: A REAL Trap 4 payload, caught in the wild while setting this project up. Look at what the outer envelope says: HTTP 200 on the wire, top-level status_code 20000, status_message "Ok." The ONLY signal that anything went wrong is tasks[0].status_code = 40207, plus tasks_error: 1. A client that checks the HTTP status sees success. A client that checks the top-level status_code ALSO sees success. Both then read result: null as 'this SERP has no competitors' -- and score every market in the corpus as a wide-open jackpot. Note also that the credentials here are perfectly VALID; bad credentials would have produced an honest 401. This failure mode requires everything to be right except one setting.

tasks.status_message: Access denied. Your IP is not whitelisted. You can modify your IP whitelist in the user panel https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access .
